title: Karol G, Rod Wave, Ella Langley & More: Highlights of This Week’s Billboard Charts
summary: All of Billboard’s charts update today.
contentText:
Today is new Billboard chart day! As all charts update each Tuesday, and on Wednesdays during holiday weeks, here’s a look at highlights of the latest rankings, dated Sept. 12 and reflecting the Aug. 28-Sept. 3 measurement week, according to data tracker Luminate.

Among this week’s chart stars are Karol G , Rod Wave, Ella Langley, Ariana Grande, Shakira and Burna Boy.

As previously reported , Karol G, Judeline and rusowsky’s “BbY WOW” hits No. 1 on both the Billboard Global 200 and Billboard Global Excl. U.S. charts. Karol G adds her second leader on the lists, after “TQG,” with fellow Colombian superstar Shakira, led in its debut week in March 2023. Judeline and rusowsky rule the charts for the first time.

“BbY WOW” concurrently crowns Hot Latin Songs for a third week, marking Karol G’s longest-leading hit since “Si Antes Te Hubiera Conocido” tallied a personal-best 14 weeks at No. 1 beginning in July 2024.

On the Billboard Hot 100 , “BbY WOW” bounds 29-16. It becomes Karol G’s third top 20 hit on the chart, following “TQG” (No. 7 peak, 2023) and “Mamiii,” with Becky G (No. 15, 2022).

Meanwhile, “BbY WOW” parent album No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto notches a fourth week at No. 1 on Top Latin Albums , having become Karol G’s fifth total and consecutive leading set.
